_metadata.description: Requirements for CLI, UI, and quality-loop integration.

requirements.title: Provide CLI validation and describe commands
requirements.description: CLI manifest declares validate scenario and describe scenario commands with read/run_eligible governance and generated Connect bindings.

validation.notes: Run `vrooli scenario test proto-health` and cli-health once commands are implemented.

requirements.title: Wire proto findings into quality loop
requirements.description: test-genie receives FINDING_SOURCE_PROTO findings and ecosystem-manager maps them to an R2 proto-health maturity dimension.

validation.notes: Add test-genie phase tests and maturity map anti-drift tests.

requirements.title: Ship direct UI inspection surface
requirements.description: UI shows fleet proto-health status and per-scenario finding/surface details with loading, error, and empty states.

validation.notes: Vitest + a11y coverage for loading/error/empty and populated states.
